findings.issue: The app ships zero tests and no test infrastructure (no script, no runner, no assertion library); all logic in app/src/lib/ and app/src/routes/ is unguarded once the external acceptance suite is retired.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest unit tests for the pure helpers in app/src/lib/format.ts and the view-model builders in app/src/lib/data.ts with apiGet stubbed, plus a small Playwright smoke suite mirroring the app's own contracts.

findings.issue: buildPokemonPageData fetches every referenced move via Promise.all inside withNotFound; a single missing/404 move record turns the entire Pokémon page into Not Found.
findings.suggestion: Tolerate missing nested records (skip the row or fall back to the humanized name) and add a test with a stubbed 404 move.

findings.issue: Only ApiError 404 is mapped to notFound(); any 5xx or network failure escapes with no errorComponent defined anywhere, so users get the framework's default error page.
findings.suggestion: Define a root/route errorComponent and test the non-404 failure path.

findings.issue: The displayed page is clamped to totalPages but the URL keeps the stale ?page=N, so URL and content disagree for out-of-range pages; nothing pins this.
findings.suggestion: Clamp and rewrite the search param (or reject), and add a test for ?page=999, ?page=abc and page boundaries (48/49th items).

findings.issue: Mixed-type cell values silently fall back to String() comparison, which misorders numbers ('9' > '10'); the missing-values-last invariant at lines 34-37 is also unpinned.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for sortRows covering null-last in both directions, numeric vs string columns, and a mixed-type column.

findings.issue: hiddenById uses last-write-wins over ability.pokemon entries; if a Pokémon ever appears twice (hidden and not), the final flag depends on API entry order.
findings.suggestion: Track hidden-ness per (id, hidden) pair or assert the invariant with a unit test.

findings.issue: staleTime: Infinity plus process-wide caches (app/src/lib/api.ts:16-33) mean a long-lived session never re-fetches home data; the spec's live-data requirement is guarded only by the acceptance overlay fixtures.
findings.suggestion: Add an integration test that a data change is reflected (or document/set a finite staleTime) so the caching contract is explicit.

summary: The app contains no tests and no test infrastructure; every behavioural contract is enforced only by the external acceptance suite. The untested surface is exactly the risky surface: ref→species card mapping with alt-form exclusion, client-side filtering/pagination with URL state, sortable tables with missing-values-last semantics, and 404/non-404 error paths (one missing nested move record currently 404s a whole Pokémon page). For a codebase owned for years, the highest-value additions are vitest unit tests for format.ts and the data.ts builders, plus a couple of Playwright smoke tests the team controls.
